ac:rich-text-body.p: This page is part of the company Database Security Configuration Policy (SEC-POL-DB-001). Its requirements are mandatory for every database in scope. Deviations need an approved entry in the DB Security – Exceptions Register. CIS Benchmarks and Tenable audit files are the technical basis and assessment method; where this policy differs from CIS, this policy applies.

ul.li: No CIS Benchmark and no native Tenable database checks. Every control on this page is reviewed MANUALLY until the custom audit is built (see the Automation status in each row).
Node OS (SLES) hardening follows the company Linux standard and is scanned by the Tenable Unix audit.
VantageCloud Lake: controls the provider manages are N/A.

td.p: Supported release with current PUT / patches
The system runs a supported Vantage release and current efixes within the patch SLA.
SELECT InfoData FROM DBC.DBCInfoV in the approved version list
Manual: query DBC.DBCInfoV
DBC user protected
The DBC user is not used for daily administration, has a vaulted password, and can log on only from approved hosts.
DBC password in PAM; logon rules limit DBC to approved hosts; no direct DBC sessions in DBC.LogOnOffV outside break-glass
Manual: DBC.LogonRulesV and DBC.LogOnOffV
System password and lockout defaults
System-wide password defaults meet the corporate password standard.
PasswordMinChar ≥ 14, digits and special characters required, MaxLogonAttempts ≤ 5, LockedUserExpire ≥ 30 min, ExpirePassword ≤ 90 days, PasswordReuse ≥ 365 days
Manual: SELECT * FROM DBC.SysSecDefaults
Central authentication
Human users authenticate through LDAP / Kerberos (TDGSS). TD2 (database) authentication is limited to service and break-glass accounts.
Default mechanism LDAP or KRB5 in TDGSS config; TD2 users listed and approved
Manual: TDGSS configuration on the TPA node
Role-based access, no PUBLIC grants
Access is granted through roles. Nothing is granted to PUBLIC or ALL beyond defaults, and WITH GRANT OPTION is limited to administrators.
No user-level grants outside admin accounts in DBC.AllRightsV; no GrantAuthority = 'Y' to non-admins
Manual: DBC.AllRightsV, DBC.AllRoleRightsV
Dictionary access restricted
Users see only the dictionary rows about objects they can access (X views), and direct access to DBC tables is revoked from PUBLIC.
Applications use DBC.*VX views; PUBLIC SELECT on DBC tables revoked
Manual: DBC.AllRightsV WHERE UserName = 'PUBLIC'
Encryption in transit
Client connections are encrypted with TLS (Vantage 17.10+) or TDGSS confidentiality.
TLS enabled on the gateway with TLS 1.2+, or TDGSS ConfidentialityRequired = yes (AES-256)
Manual: gateway (gtwcontrol) and TDGSS configuration
Encryption at rest
Systems holding Confidential data use self-encrypting drives or Vantage storage encryption; backups are encrypted.
SED / storage encryption enabled; backup encryption enabled in DSA / BAR
Manual: platform evidence from Teradata support
Not visible from SQL; evidence collected annually.
Access logging and DBQL
Logons, failed logons, grants / revokes and access to sensitive objects are logged; DBQL is enabled; logs are forwarded to the SIEM.
Access logging rules in DBC.AccLogRulesV for GRANT, REVOKE, CREATE / DROP USER; DBQL active in DBC.DBQLRulesV
Manual: DBC.AccLogRulesV, DBC.DBQLRulesV
Logon rules restrict client hosts
Logon rules allow each privileged user only from approved client hosts.
GRANT LOGON ON <host> TO <user> rules present for privileged users
Manual: DBC.LogonRulesV
